title: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security & Multi-Tenant CMS Isolation

requirement.summary: Multi-tenant CMS core must enforce strict isolation between merchants across all database queries, server actions, and REST endpoints, guaranteeing that Merchant A cannot read, mutate, or join against Merchant B's documents, revisions, or media.
requirement.user_outcome: Store data and merchant content remain completely isolated; no unauthorized cross-tenant data traversal, tampering, or disclosure is possible.
preconditions: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security enabled on storefront_pages, articles, revisions, and media
Authenticated session context provides verified merchant_id via staff membership claim

protected_behaviour: Queries for pages, articles, or revisions filter strictly by the authenticated tenant ID
Client-supplied merchant_id in payloads or query params is ignored in favor of session context
Cross-tenant joins or foreign key queries return zero records and log security warnings
Anonymous shoppers only access published content filtered by active domain tenant mapping
forbidden_behaviour: Direct IDOR access allowing one tenant to fetch another tenant's documents
Forged merchant_id payloads bypassing session authorization
Data leakage across tenant boundaries in draft preview or revision history

executable_model.correspondence_bridge: src/lib/cms-tenant-rls.test.ts synchronized with database RLS policies

adversarial_checks.mutation_description: Disable tenant filter in page query to allow foreign tenant access
adversarial_checks.expected_failure_snippet: expected cross-tenant access to throw or return null

adversarial_checks.mutation_description: Accept client-supplied merchant_id over authenticated session claim
adversarial_checks.expected_failure_snippet: expected forged tenant query to be rejected
